cases.name: one command is one segment
cases.why: A command with no separator is one segment.

cases.name: a pipe and a redirection
cases.why: The redirection and its target are set aside, and the pipe splits.

input.command:
a && b || c; d | e |& f & g
h

cases.name: separators of every kind split
cases.why: `&&`, `||`, `;`, `|`, `|&`, `&`, and a line feed all split.

input.command:
npm test < input.txt && git status > s.txt
ls &

cases.name: an input redirection is set aside with its target
cases.why: The target of `<` is not a word of the command.

cases.name: quoted separators stay in the word
cases.why: A separator inside quotes belongs to the word.

cases.name: redirections in the middle are set aside
cases.why: An operator and its target can come anywhere in the command.

cases.name: an empty line has no segment
cases.why: A line that holds only separators has no command.

cases.name: a heredoc body is not a segment
cases.why: The body of a heredoc is data.

cases.name: the delimiter of a heredoc is not a word
cases.why: The delimiter is the target of `<<`.

cases.name: a here-string target is not a word
cases.why: The target of `<<<` is data.

cases.name: single quotes keep a backslash
cases.why: Inside single quotes a backslash is a character.

cases.name: double quotes drop the backslash of an escape
cases.why: A backslash in double quotes escapes the next character.

cases.name: an escaped separator stays in the word
cases.why: A backslash before `;` keeps it in the word.

cases.name: an escaped line feed joins the lines
cases.why: A backslash before a line feed continues the line.

cases.name: a path as the command word is kept
cases.why: The command word is not shortened to its last segment.

cases.name: an environment assignment is the first word
cases.why: The assignment is a word of the command.

cases.name: a word with a variable is kept as written
cases.why: The gate does not expand a variable.

cases.name: a command substitution is kept as written
cases.why: The gate does not run a substitution.

cases.name: an fd duplication is dropped
cases.why: `2>&1` is not a word.

cases.name: a bare >& is a redirection with a target
cases.why: `>&` followed by a name redirects to a file.

description: The commands of a shell line, split the way the exec check reads it.
